accuracyFlags.claim: Section 07: 'A national park pass covers Uluru-Kata Tjuta and is bought in advance.' No fee, date or source, and the pass does not have to be bought in advance.
accuracyFlags.correct: An Uluṟu-Kata Tjuṯa park pass is required: $38/adult for 3 days or $50/adult for a year, under-18s free; NT-registered private vehicle annual pass $109. Parks Australia recommends buying online but it can be bought at the park entry station. Covers Uluṟu-Kata Tjuṯa only, not Watarrka/Kings Canyon. Prices checked October 2026.
accuracyFlags.fix: Sec 07 park pass: not required in advance (online or entry station); $38/adult 3-day, $50 annual, under-18 free, NT vehicle annual $109; Uluṟu-Kata Tjuṯa only; date Oct 2026 + link uluru.gov.au/plan/passes

accuracyFlagsOriginal: Intro says 'Seven to ten days' while section 04 says 'Four days each way at a sensible pace' (8 days driving plus Yulara); the totals contradict.
'A national park pass covers Uluru-Kata Tjuta and is bought in advance' gives no fee or date and no Parks Australia source; park fees and conditions are the sort of fact that must be dated for 2026.
Title and H1 use 'Uluṟu' with a dotted ṟ; the plain spelling 'Uluru' is what people search, so the page matches the query poorly.
rejectedFlags: Intro 7-10 days vs section 04 'four days each way': wording ambiguity, not a factual error (say 'one way').
Title/H1 'Uluṟu' spelling: official Parks Australia spelling; adding plain 'Uluru' is an SEO choice.
